summary: Gateway settings load in order: application settings.py, defaults.py, /etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/settings.py, grpc_default.py, gateway/grpc_settings.py (gRPC only), /etc/ansible-automation-platform/settings.py (all services), then environment variables last.
questions: In what order does the platform gateway load settings files?
Do environment variables override settings.py in AAP?
Which settings apply only to the gRPC server?

answer_card.title: Gateway settings load order
answer_card.answer_md:
Later wins:
1. Application `settings.py`
2. `defaults.py`
3. `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/settings.py` (API + gRPC)
4. `grpc_default.py` (gRPC)
5. `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/grpc_settings.py` (gRPC only)
6. `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/settings.py` (all services on the node)
7. Environment variables
